scope: Every unique reference actually cited in main, supplement, and separate spectral record; uncited legacy library entries excluded.

entries.claim_alignment: Usable information can increase under computation; not Shannon conditional information.
Validated posterior-summary error control; not a generic guarantee that any ELBO or diagnostic bounds forward predictive KL.
Variational information lower bound. PDF title is The IM Algorithm; proceedings landing page uses Information Maximization in Noisy Channels: A Variational Approach. Same authors and paper.
Bayesian experimental design already optimizes information objectives. PDF uses Eli Bingham and Tom Rainforth; metadata uses Elias and Thomas. These are author-name variants, not different authors.
General divergence comparison and reverse-Pinsker bounds; does not independently verify priority of the new fixed-reference formula.
Limitations of distribution-free mutual-information lower bounds; not an impossibility result under the supplied-model assumptions here.
Modern convergence diagnostics; diagnostics are not rigorous predictive approximation budgets. Journal version 2021, not preprint year 2019.
Joint ranges of divergence pairs and binary-support geometry; manuscript keeps separate the fixed-q least-mass reduction.
Variational MI bounds and bias/variance tradeoffs; not empirical superiority of this audit.
Dataset citation, not clinical validation. UCI itself lists Nick Street and W. Street separately; retained official citation without guessing a correction.
Model-X conditional-feature assumptions; manuscript does not present knockoffs as the identical HRT procedure.
HRT sample splitting and conditional resampling. Journal DOI 10.1080/10618600.2021.1923520; volume31(1),151–162,2022.
Conditional predictive impact and conditional replacements; does not provide the same numerical information bound.
Pointwise V-information for instance difficulty relative to a predictive family.
Proper-score reliability and resolution decomposition. Author PDF verifies journal135(643),1512–1519,2009.
Dataset source has5620 records; manuscript explicitly uses the1797-record sklearn subset.
Inter-model latent agreement as a reliability signal; contextual comparator, not a claim that the method was reproduced identically.
Input atypicality supplements confidence; acknowledges input-aware reliability precedent.
Concept-based failure detection, AAAI39(25),26326–26334; supports novelty boundary.
Betting-based mean bounds and confidence sequences; concentration machinery credited as existing.
Empirical Bernstein inequality used after bounded-range scaling; not a newly derived concentration inequality.
Hardness of unrestricted conditional independence testing; scoped separately from report-only non-identifiability here.
Proper log scores, entropy and divergence foundations; established risk identity.
Predictive uncertainty under dataset shift; cited only for supporting-study motivation, not shift certification.
Limitations of selective-classification evaluation and AUGRC; supporting-record discussion, not this audit target.
Grouping loss beyond calibration; distinguishes an estimated component from an upper bound on total baseline error.
Nested-information proper-score decompositions. Marked as an arXiv preprint, not a peer-reviewed conference paper.
LOCO contrasts predictive losses; not every variable-importance estimand is a fitted-model contrast.
Nonparametric variable importance; optimal-risk rather than only fitted-model target.
Algorithm-agnostic risk contrasts and asymptotic inference; log-loss optimal-risk contrast equals conditional information.
Modified LOCO target reduces dependence on covariate correlation; not identical to conditional information.
Model-X lower inference on minimum-MSE improvement using a working regression; not merely a test.
Asymptotic lower bounds on normalized expected total variation; can imply information lower bounds through Pinsker.
Official dataset citation year; public records do not establish iid population sampling.
